package.name: JOKZET Labs Daily Learning Programme
package.description: Weekly recurring practical learning missions and due-time reminders.

notification.fallback: Show an in-app reminder the next time the user opens the app if browser notifications are unavailable.

rules.cybersecurity: Only use systems owned by the learner, explicitly authorized targets, or intentionally vulnerable training labs.
rules.privacy: Never request or store passwords, API keys, tokens, or private keys as mission evidence.

weeklyMissions.title: Full-stack Development
weeklyMissions.objective: Build and improve practical frontend, backend, database, and application development skills.

agenda.task: Follow a short video demonstration relevant to today's development skill.
Complete the guided coding task and make the feature work.
Extend the solution, change an assumption, or test an edge case.
Submit code, screenshots, a Git commit, repository link, or working demo.
Review the submitted evidence against the mission acceptance criteria.

weeklyMissions.notificationTitle: Today's JOKZET Labs mission: Full-stack Development

weeklyMissions.title: UI/UX Design
weeklyMissions.objective: Develop practical interface design, prototyping, usability, and design-system skills.

agenda.task: Watch a visual design demonstration.
Create or improve a practical interface in Figma or another design tool.
Try an alternative layout, interaction, or responsive state.
Submit screenshots, a prototype link, and a short design rationale.
Evaluate the submitted work against usability and visual-quality criteria.

weeklyMissions.notificationTitle: Today's JOKZET Labs mission: UI/UX Design

weeklyMissions.title: Ethical Hacking and Cybersecurity
weeklyMissions.objective: Build defensive security knowledge and practical testing skills in authorized environments.

agenda.task: Watch a practical security demonstration.
Complete the assigned exercise in an owned system or authorized training lab.
Test a safe variation within the authorized environment.
Submit screenshots, commands, findings, and remediation notes with secrets removed.
Evaluate the evidence for correctness, authorization, impact awareness, and remediation.

weeklyMissions.notificationTitle: Today's JOKZET Labs mission: Ethical Hacking and Cybersecurity

weeklyMissions.title: Cloud Computing and Server Administration
weeklyMissions.objective: Develop practical skills in cloud infrastructure, Linux, networking, deployment, and server operations.

agenda.task: Watch a practical setup, administration, or troubleshooting demonstration.
Configure, deploy, or administer the assigned service or system.
Test a configuration change, monitoring check, or recovery procedure.
Submit terminal output, screenshots, sanitized configuration, and results.
Evaluate correctness, reliability, security, and troubleshooting process.

weeklyMissions.notificationTitle: Today's JOKZET Labs mission: Cloud and Server Administration

weeklyMissions.title: AI, Automation, Business and Career
weeklyMissions.objective: Build useful AI and automation workflows and connect technical skills to business and career outcomes.

agenda.task: Watch a practical AI, automation, business, or career demonstration.
Build a small working workflow, prototype, or business deliverable.
Improve the workflow and test edge cases or failure conditions.
Submit a demo, screenshots, workflow export, or project link.
Evaluate usefulness, reliability, quality, and measurable outcome.

weeklyMissions.notificationTitle: Today's JOKZET Labs mission: AI, Automation and Business

weeklyMissions.title: Photography and Video Production
weeklyMissions.objective: Build practical visual storytelling, smartphone photography, filming, lighting, and editing skills.

agenda.task: Watch a visual demonstration of composition, lighting, filming, or editing.
Capture and edit the assigned photo or video exercise using available equipment.
Try a different shot, lighting setup, edit, or storytelling technique.
Submit original captures and the final edited output.
Evaluate composition, exposure, sound, editing, storytelling, and technical quality as applicable.

weeklyMissions.notificationTitle: Today's JOKZET Labs mission: Photography and Video

weeklyMissions.title: Weekly Review, Assessment and Portfolio
weeklyMissions.objective: Review actual work completed, assess submitted evidence, correct weaknesses, and plan the next week.

agenda.task: Review the week's attempted and completed missions.
Submit missing evidence for work that was completed.
Assess only evidence actually submitted against the relevant acceptance criteria.
Record failed criteria and complete corrections or remediation tasks.
Select portfolio-worthy work and update project records.
Set priorities for the next week's missions.

weeklyMissions.notificationTitle: JOKZET Labs weekly review and assessment

expectedBehavior: Validate the schema version and required fields before importing.
Show a preview of all seven recurring weekly missions before confirmation.
Create or update schedule templates without duplicating existing missions.
Preserve the user's existing app theme and layout.
Create daily mission instances from the weekly templates beginning on the configured start date.
Schedule reminders in the Africa/Accra timezone.
Ask for browser notification permission only after an explicit user action.
Show an in-app due reminder even if browser notification permission is denied.
Record notification delivery attempts and mission completion status.
Allow the user to edit reminder time, duration, and notification preferences.
importInstructions.important: Importing this file defines the schedule and reminder settings. Actual notifications require the application to implement a reminder scheduler and notification delivery.
